sloka: एते ऽत्र बलवन्तो हि भीमकायाश्च वानराः ।द्रुमशैलप्रहरणास्तिष्ठन्ति प्रमुखे मम ।। ६.५६.४ ।।।।
transliteration: ete 'tra balavanto hi bhīmakāyāśca vānarāḥ ।drumaśailapraharaṇāstiṣṭhanti pramukhe mama ।। 6.56.4 ।।।।

translations.english: "Those Vanaras are mighty and terribly angry. They are using trees and hillocks as weapons. Take me where chiefs are standing."
